name: Ambient Occlusion via Shadow Rays
definition: Approximating ambient occlusion by casting shadow rays and incorporating a falloff function into the sampling scheme, rather than averaging hemisphere rays mapped to a falloff function.
summary: Ambient Occlusion via Shadow Rays approximates indirect light by casting rays into the hemisphere to determine geometric occlusion, differing from screen-space methods by using explicit ray tracing against scene geometry or volume.
